searchText: Hey everyone, hope all is great. Curious if there is anyone who could help me as I'm contemplating whether it's realistic for me to set up an eth validator / and have some questions. I'm not technically savvy either, so it's been a bit of a challenge to say the least. Anyone here that I can chat with? Thank you, much appreciated Have you already reviewed <https://launchpad.ethereum.org/>? <@!301186049323958275> - I haven't but I will now, and revert back with questions - if that's cool with you? Setup is pretty simple if you’ve used eth before <@!636289909359116290> - ok that's good to hear 🙂
